# The estate's YAML-extension exemptions. ONE PLACE, deliberately: an exemption
# added here reaches every repository that calls this action, and a repository
# cannot grant itself one.
#
# Format: <kind>:<value>|<the tool that dictates the spelling>
#
#   name:<basename>   the tool reads exactly that filename
#   dir:<prefix>      the tool reads any name under that directory
#
# ⚠️ AN EXEMPTION NAMES A TOOL, NOT A PREFERENCE. "we prefer .yml" is not an
# entry. If the tool accepts both spellings there is nothing to exempt — which
# is why action.yml is NOT here: GitHub documents action.yml and action.yaml
# both, so arqtiqa/arqtos-core#206 ruled they are renamed, not exempted.

name:dependabot.yml|GitHub reads only .github/dependabot.yml; .yaml is not supported

# ⚠️ DIRECTORY-KEYED, and the difference from the line above is the point.
# GitHub reads ANY name under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, so a name-keyed entry
# would either miss a template added tomorrow or spare a bug.yml anywhere in
# the tree. The tool's rule is about the directory, so the entry is too.
dir:.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/|GitHub's issue-forms documentation names only .yml, and a wrong extension does not error - the template silently stops appearing
